headline.normal_current_basis: RMS (9.0007 A worst line, 18.0 percent of a 50 A rating); the 4.49 A average is not a sizing basis
headline.applicable_fwp_revision: current revision, 700 Vdc (50 kAIC at 700 Vdc); the retained 2011-2014 revision's 800 Vdc is NOT the ordered-part figure
headline.candidate_with_applicable_capacitor_disc: A70QS50-14F (890 Vdc for capacitor discharges up to a 2.5 ms time constant); FWP-50A14F has none

normal_current_waveform.carried_by: F2 (proposed series fuse in the DC bus, inside the internal discharge loop)
normal_current_waveform.basis: RMS of the boost-diode current, because Eaton's retained FWP sheet expresses its loss correction Kp against RMS load current
normal_current_waveform.repetitive_pulses: 129.1 kHz pulse train merges thermally inside the fuse element; RMS includes the pulse duty
normal_current_waveform.note: an average-based size would undersize heating by roughly half

fault_impedance_envelope.model: series R-L-C, constant lumped R, no arc, no evolving short residual; total action integral = 179.2376 J / R, independent of L

peak_current.peak_within_fwp_50ka_condition: R >= ~8.9 mOhm at the lowest L (L ~ 20-32 nH); for R >= 10 mOhm the peak is inside 50 kA across the sweep
peak_current.caveat: the 50 kA DC breaking capacity is specified for an L/R DC test, not a capacitor-discharge waveshape; the peak comparison is a screen, not a clearing criterion

melts.note: adiabatic melt screen; independent of L because the total action integral is E/R

A70QS50-14F.relation_to_melting: under the natural capacitor-discharge reading tau = R*C, the A70QS50-14F melts only for R <= 0.640 ohm, where R*C <= 1.43 ms, so the stated 2.5 ms condition holds wherever it melts; the manufacturer does not define its 'time constant' explicitly, so this reading should be confirmed
A70QS50-14F.status: manufacturer class guidance, not a board-specific demonstrated coordination (let-through vs bank/copper withstand unresolved)

clears.note: the FWP cells stay null: an AC/inductive clearing I2t cannot be applied to a capacitor discharge

applicable_clearing_data.a70qs50_14f_at_400vdc: 890 Vdc capacitor-discharge rating up to a 2.5 ms time constant (manufacturer catalogue)
applicable_clearing_data.what_would_resolve: an Eaton capacitor-discharge rating / let-through characteristic for FWP-50A14F, plus a sourced bank / PCB-copper withstand I2t to compare against
